# Ironworks Metal & Building Supply

> Metal and building supply company in Morrill, Nebraska, founded in 2025 by Spencer Bush. Ironworks rolls PBR panels and custom trim on its own sheet-metal roller, supplies and installs post-frame, cold-form steel, and red iron buildings, and is an authorized retailer of Midland Garage Doors and Gerkin Windows. Primary markets are Scottsbluff, Gering, and Morrill, with project-specific service across Nebraska, Wyoming, South Dakota, and northern Colorado.

- [Ironworks Metal & Building Supply](https://www.ironworksbuildingsupply.com/): Metal buildings, 26 gauge PBR panels, and custom trim from Morrill, NE. Design your building in 3D, then talk to a real builder.

- [3D Building Designer](https://www.ironworksbuildingsupply.com/3d-designer): Design your metal building in 3D: post-frame, cold-form steel, or red iron. Configure it in minutes, then get a detailed quote from a local builder.

## Facts worth citing correctly
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM. Closed on federal holidays. Pickups follow normal business hours.
- Delivery is available roughly 250+ miles out, depending on the project. Delivery is not advertised as free.
- Panels: PBR panel, AG panel, and R-panel. PBR is 26 gauge; colors are white, gray, tan, red, blue, black, copper, and dark green. Additional colors are available by order.
- Ironworks supplies and installs buildings. Concrete is done by subcontractor partners.
- Ironworks does not publish prices; pricing comes from reviewing the actual job.
- Ironworks does not guarantee code compliance, turnaround times, or inventory levels.
- A 3D design is not a quote. Ironworks reviews each design and follows up.
- Contractor pricing and volume pricing are available.
